exam_scheme.note: Under RRB CEN 04/2024, recruitment is conducted through a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination. The CBT consists of 100 objective questions totaling 100 marks with a duration of 90 minutes (120 minutes for eligible PwBD candidates). The scheme places heavy 70% weightage on Professional Ability (domain medical/technical subject), with 1/3 (0.33) marks deducted for every incorrect response.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for the premier post of Nursing Superintendent at Level 7 entry basic pay (₹44,900) with 58% DA (₹26,042), HRA (9%/18%/27%), Transport Allowance, and Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/mo) / Hospital Patient Care Allowance (HPCA). Other posts span Level 3 (Laboratory Assistant: ₹21,700 basic), Level 5 (Pharmacist, Radiographer: ₹29,200 basic), and Level 6 (Health & Malaria Inspector: ₹35,400 basic).
official_perks: Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/month) or Hospital Patient Care Allowance (HPCA / PCA)
Annual Uniform and Dress Allowance for healthcare personnel
All-India free 1st Class / AC Railway Passes and Privilege Ticket Orders (PTOs) for self and family
Free comprehensive medical care in Indian Railway Hospitals and referral super-specialty health centers
Railway residential quarters or House Rent Allowance (9%/18%/27%)
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Government matching contribution

competition_benchmarks.note: RRB Paramedical recruits specialized clinical personnel for Indian Railways. CEN 04/2024 notified 1,376 vacancies across 17 paramedical categories, led by 713 Nursing Superintendent and 246 Pharmacist posts. The prior recruitment drive (CEN 02/2019) advertised 1,937 vacancies.
